name: seadex-scout
description: Keeps your Sonarr and Radarr anime library in sync with the best releases on SeaDex, the community list of the best release for each show. Tells you when SeaDex lists a better release than yours, or a newer v2 or REPACK of it, and writes an on-demand report comparing each season you have with SeaDex. It leaves downloads to Sonarr and Radarr. It can also offer SeaDex's picks to them as a Torznab indexer, so they download under your quality rules.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: config.yaml, state and the reports folder

ports.name: Torznab port
ports.description: Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr. It listens only when a Torznab URL is configured in config.yaml

variables.name: Sonarr URL
variables.description: Where seadex-scout reaches Sonarr, including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:8989. Use the server's LAN IP, not a container name

variables.name: Sonarr API key
variables.description: Sonarr's API key, from Settings, then General, then API Key in Sonarr

variables.name: Radarr URL
variables.description: Where seadex-scout reaches Radarr, for example http://192.0.2.100:7878. Leave empty to watch Sonarr only

variables.name: Radarr API key
variables.description: Radarr's API key, from Settings, then General, then API Key in Radarr. Required when Radarr URL is set
